crossRefs.note: But now, brothers, if I come to you speaking with other languages, what would I profit you, unless I speak to you…
What is it then, brothers? When you come together, each one of you has a psalm, has a teaching, has a revelation, has…
“Behold, I waited for your words, and I listened for your reasoning, while you searched out what to say.
“They are amazed. They answer no more. They don’t have a word to say.
Mark well, Job, and listen to me. Hold your peace, and I will speak.

translations.web: But if a revelation is made to another sitting by, let the first keep silent.
translations.bsb: And if a revelation comes to someone who is seated, the first speaker should stop.
translations.kjv: If any thing be revealed to another that sitteth by, let ➔ the first hold his peace.
translations.asv: But if a revelation be made to another sitting by, let the first keep silence.
